"clip-box": children flush against bg on all sides (no inset) → Text is too close to the edge of its container. Two shapes: (1) an element with its own text where the space between the rendered text and the border box is too small for the font size, and (2) a wrapper whose children's text lands flush against a visible boundary (border, outline, or non-transparent background) with nothing to inset it. Add at least 8px (ideally 12–16px) of space inside bordered, outlined, or colored containers.
